answer: Want 1,000 fakes? Auction: 100 slots per epoch, bids sealed, each locks 3 epochs. Bid 60 each; clearing takes 60,000. Demand doubles, price doubles. You wander in quietly, but a relic of your funding trail remains: one wallet's bids cluster, and a 2-epoch window burns fakes. Honest losers get 2% less back; you lose the whole bid. Clones cost 60,000 at best, 120,000 doubled; the bridge to profit burns first. Forgery pays market rate.
